80561.title: Incorrect S3 metadata path resolution when config is populated in Iceberg REST catalog /v1/config response
80561.feasibility_reason: The issue describes a clear bug involving path normalization when an Iceberg REST catalog /v1/config response includes s3.endpoint, causing duplicate prefix concatenation. However, fixing this requires understanding ClickHouse's internal Iceberg REST catalog integration and how metadata_location and data_location paths are resolved relative to endpoint configurations.
blockers: Familiarity with ClickHouse's Iceberg REST catalog implementation and path resolution logic.
80561.problem_summary: When ClickHouse queries an Iceberg REST catalog that returns catalog config like `s3.endpoint`, `metadata_location` and `data_location` may have inconsistent URI schemes or endpoints (e.g., `s3://...` vs `http://...`). ClickHouse's metadata path calculation attempts a naive string prefix check (`metadata_location.starts_with(data_location)`), which fails due to prefix mismatch, leading to malformed double S3 path keys like `s3://examples/.../s3://examples/...`.
80561.root_cause_hypothesis: The metadata parsing logic in ClickHouse assumes `data_location` and `metadata_location` use identical string prefixes (e.g., both start with `s3://`). When `s3.endpoint` is configured in the Iceberg REST catalog response, `data_location` or the table endpoint prefix may differ from `metadata_location`, causing `starts_with` comparison to fail and appending the full `metadata_location` URI to the target key path.
80561.suggested_approach: Normalize `metadata_location` and `data_location` before resolving relative paths by stripping scheme prefixes (`s3://`, `http://`, `https://`) and host/endpoint prefixes, or by parsing both locations into bucket and object key components to reliably extract the relative path of the metadata file.
prerequisites: Set up a local ClickHouse development environment with C++ toolchain and tests.
Set up an Iceberg REST catalog (e.g. Apache Lakekeeper or Nessie) pointing to MinIO with custom endpoint config to reproduce the issue.
implementation_steps: Locate the path normalization logic in Iceberg metadata resolution where `metadata_location.starts_with(data_location)` is checked.
Implement a helper function to extract the relative S3 key from a location URL by stripping scheme protocols (e.g., `s3://`, `http://`, `https://`), host/port parts, and bucket names.

Update the metadata path calculation logic to use the helper function so that relative metadata keys are resolved properly regardless of endpoint or URI scheme differences between `data_location` and `metadata_location`.
Add unit tests and integration tests covering REST catalog configurations with custom `s3.endpoint` values and mixed scheme URIs.
